name: Jugol's Rest
summary: The campaign's home city: an ancient settlement much larger than its present population requires.
description: A city of old infrastructure, active factions, and rediscovered mysteries. Its districts contain places of worship, markets, scholarly institutions, and the Coalescence Society's local lodge.

name: Northern Docks
summary: Jugol's Rest's primary port and waterfront district.
description: Trade and transportation by water sustain a lively area of businesses, travelers, and dock workers.

name: Riverside Tavern
summary: A lively gathering place for travelers and dock workers.
description: Known for food and company near the Northern Docks.

name: Coalescence Lodge
summary: Local headquarters and information point for the Coalescence Society.
description: A place to seek information and support regarding the annual Coalescence.

name: Verdant Grove
summary: A green sanctuary within Jugol's Rest.
description: Associated with the Verdant Enclave. Gruxx retired from adventuring to work here with the sage.

name: Heart District
summary: The historic civic and cultural heart of Jugol's Rest.
description: Original district notes describe old stone buildings and the city's public institutions. Specific sites are being reconciled against session records.

name: Arcane Quarter
summary: A district associated with magical study and research.
description: Home to the city's arcane interests and the Arcane Consortium.

name: Market Ward
summary: The busy commercial district of Jugol's Rest.
description: Trade, markets, taverns and merchants make this a natural place to seek supplies and rumors.

name: Grand Cathedral of Dawn
summary: A major place of worship associated with the Radiant Order.
description: The old city notes place the cathedral in the Heart District.

name: Council Hall
summary: A seat of civic deliberation in Jugol's Rest.
description: The old city notes describe it as the center of political activity.

name: Eternal Flame Theatre
summary: A venue for performance and artistic expression.
description: The old city notes associate it with the Flame Seekers.

name: World Tree Sanctuary
summary: A sacred sanctuary within the Verdant Grove.
description: A place for meditation and rituals associated with the Verdant Enclave.

name: Elders' Hall
summary: A gathering place for the Verdant Enclave's elders.
description: The old notes describe it as a council and meeting hall.

name: Riverfront Bazaar
summary: A busy marketplace known for varied goods.
description: A public commercial gathering point in the Market Ward.

name: The Gilded Coin
summary: A tavern with ties to the Shadow Syndicate.
description: Known in old city notes as a meeting place for syndicate members.

name: Arcane Spire
summary: The Arcane Consortium's scholarly headquarters.
description: An institution devoted to magical research and education.

name: Alchemists' Guildhall
summary: A center for potion brewing and alchemical research.
description: Associated with the Arcane Consortium in the original city notes.

name: Coalescence Society
summary: A global organization that responds to planar breaches and the annual Coalescence.
description: Its newest local chapter operates in Jugol's Rest. The Society protects the Forge and is taking operational responsibility for investigating the ancient railroad.

name: Arcane Consortium
summary: Scholars and practitioners concerned with arcane knowledge and infrastructure.
description: An established organization with a presence in Jugol's Rest.

name: Radiant Order
summary: Faith-led protectors with a strong civic presence.
description: Known for guardianship, worship, and public service.

name: Verdant Enclave
summary: Stewards of nature and its balance.
description: Associated with the Verdant Grove and its sanctuaries.

name: Flame Seekers
summary: An organization involved in expeditions and cultural activity.
description: Associated with the Eternal Flame Theatre in early city records.

name: Shadow Syndicate
summary: A network of brokers, merchants and less-public operators.
description: Known for connections within the city's commercial and undercity networks.

name: Embered Circle
summary: A faction among the organizations active in the campaign.
description: Its history and public role will be expanded from the original faction notes.

name: Kaelith Silverwind
summary: A known representative of the Coalescence Society.
description: Associated with the Society's local presence. More details will be added from original NPC records.

name: Alchemist Sage Greenleaf
summary: An alchemist and sage known to the adventurers.
description: Connected to Rufus's history. Details of the sage's role will be expanded from original notes.

name: Captain Thorn Ironshield
summary: A named captain from the original campaign records.
description: Public role and relationships await verification against the original NPC notes.

name: Gruxx
summary: A former adventuring companion who settled in the Verdant Grove.
description: Retired from the party to work with the sage; Adrian Sharpe continued in his place.

name: The Ancient Forge
summary: A dormant ancient system accidentally reawakened by the party.
description: Its activation illuminated a connected transit board, though the destinations remained inaccessible. The Coalescence Society established a protective barrier.

name: Empire of Xandria
summary: A powerful theocratic empire in the wider world.
description: Original world records name High Inquisitor Marcus Valen as leader and Dodbrigh as capital. Worship of Xandues is central to its public identity.

name: Cartel Confederacy of Sumaq
summary: A confederacy organized around powerful trade families.
description: Original records name Don Ignacio Valverde as leader and Vr'naar as capital.

name: Harmonious Republic of Zhaolingy
summary: A cosmopolitan confederacy of innovative city-states.
description: Original records name Chancellor Mei Lian and capital Cleolesbu.

name: Celestial Sultanate of Iqar
summary: A monarchy known for spirituality, artisans and trade.
description: Original records name Maharaja Arjun Suryavata and capital Brampound.
